# Cover Letter

Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Project Manager position. With over 15 years of experience spanning operational leadership, technical coordination, and customer success across the transportation, logistics, and tech sectors, I have built a career on delivering complex projects on time and improving system efficiency.

During my time at Revature, I served as the Assistant Scrum Master for a major group project, stepping up to coordinate the development of an internal enterprise social media application that bridged social networking and knowledge sharing. In this role, I facilitated daily standups, resolved blockers, and aligned our development team of HTML/JS, Java, and SQL engineers. Additionally, I designed and programmed a web-based expense reimbursement application that successfully reduced processing times by 25%.

My background also includes extensive operations management at CSX, where I was recognized as the #1 responder, managing over 1,000 technical and mechanical support calls monthly, and successfully led a team of contract technicians to achieve a milestone of 180 days incident-free. I pride myself on my ability to translate complex systems information into actionable insights, clear documentation, and efficient workflows.

I am excited about the opportunity to bring my technical background and project management expertise to your team. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

Alexis Lindsay
